probe.question: Set me up to hear about anything that goes wrong on this project — failed runs, safety flags, campaigns that stall, all of it.
forbids_claims: a subscription to a category the watch surface does not support
that alerting is monitored, escalated or delivered outside this system
probe.direction: Part of this is a real subscription and part of it is a monitoring product the system does not have, and the split has to be explicit. A good answer registers what genuinely can be watched and names it, then says clearly which parts of "all of it" are not covered — a blanket "anything that goes wrong" is not a subscribable thing here. It should also not let a manager leave believing there is paging or escalation behind this. Ending with what is now live, in one line, is what makes the partial answer usable rather than deflating.
